connections.signInDescription: {plugin} needs a connection to {provider}. Sign in to continue.
connections.pickerDescription: Your choice is saved for this plugin on this device.
connections.addScopesDescription: {plugin} needs additional access: {scopes}. Reconnect {account} to grant it. You will then review this plugin’s access at the new connection revision.
connections.setupDescription: Enter your app credentials. The Host stores the app secret; the authentication plugin never receives it. Leave the secret empty to reuse the one stored for this app and deployment.
connections.tenantScopeRequired: Grant tenant:tenant:readonly to your app and try again. The tenant could not be queried (permission denied or company unavailable).
connections.identityConflict: This account and app already have a connection through another provider. Use that connection or disconnect it before signing in here.
connections.apiKeyDescription: The Host stores this key in your connection and supplies it to the authentication provider to identify your account. It is never saved in plugin settings.

callback.done: Authorization complete — you can close this window.
callback.failedHint: You can close this window and try again from the plugin.
callback.missing: No authorization response arrived. Close this window and start sign-in again from the plugin.

deviceInstructions: Open the verification page and enter this code to sign in.
deviceExpired: The device code expired — try again
deviceActionFailed: Could not copy the code or open the verification page

runtimeSupport.title: Runtime support ({profile})
runtimeSupport.recoveryFailed: Could not open vault unlock. Try again.

reasons.no-interactive-browser: Initial sign-in needs an interactive browser.
reasons.confidential-exchange-unavailable: Confidential exchange requires a trusted Host.
reasons.no-external-callback: This runtime cannot receive an external OAuth callback.
reasons.non-persistent-until-vault-unlock: Unlock the vault to store credentials persistently.
reasons.vendor-cors-required: The service must allow browser requests (CORS).
reasons.background-sync-unavailable: Background sync does not run on this runtime.
reasons.host-process-required: Sync runs while the Host process is running.
